documents.title: Leadership coaching
documents.text: Managers develop people through mentoring, coaching and constructive feedback conversations.

documents.title: Mandatory compliance
documents.text: Required policy training must be completed annually and renewed before the due date.

documents.title: Feedback conversations
documents.text: Effective communication uses clear feedback, active listening and respectful conversation.

documents.title: Skill development
documents.text: Development plans identify proficiency gaps and mapped learning options for capability growth.

documents.title: Certificate renewal
documents.text: Certificates can expire and may require renewal before the credential validity date.

documents.title: Assessment scoring
documents.text: Assessment attempts are scored against the configured passing score and attempt limits.

documents.title: Course enrollment
documents.text: Enrollment can depend on prerequisites, capacity, assignment rules and learner eligibility.

documents.title: Manager analytics
documents.text: Team learning reports show manager populations, enrollments, completions and overdue learning.
